explanations.decision: Deployed 2 redundant L3 Core switches in collapsed-core topology
explanations.rationale: Collapsed-core topology combines core and distribution functions for campuses < 5,000 endpoints, providing high availability with lower operational complexity.

explanations.decision: Sized 17 access switches and 1 distribution switch for BLD-A
explanations.rationale: Building Building A (Engineering) (BLD-A): 620 endpoints with 20% growth buffer require 744 active drops. Using 48-port switches with 4 reserved uplink ports yields 44 usable access ports per switch. Allocated 17 access switch(es) providing 748 total access ports (4 spare ports). Calculated 26 PoE+ wireless access points (24 endpoints per AP). Allocated 1 distribution switch/stack for building aggregation.

explanations.decision: Sized 16 access switches and 1 distribution switch for BLD-B
explanations.rationale: Building Building B (Library) (BLD-B): 580 endpoints with 20% growth buffer require 696 active drops. Using 48-port switches with 4 reserved uplink ports yields 44 usable access ports per switch. Allocated 16 access switch(es) providing 704 total access ports (8 spare ports). Calculated 25 PoE+ wireless access points (24 endpoints per AP). Allocated 1 distribution switch/stack for building aggregation.

explanations.decision: Sized 11 access switches and 1 distribution switch for BLD-C
explanations.rationale: Building Building C (Admin) (BLD-C): 400 endpoints with 20% growth buffer require 480 active drops. Using 48-port switches with 4 reserved uplink ports yields 44 usable access ports per switch. Allocated 11 access switch(es) providing 484 total access ports (4 spare ports). Calculated 17 PoE+ wireless access points (24 endpoints per AP). Allocated 1 distribution switch/stack for building aggregation.
Standardized VLAN numbering ensures uniform broadcast domain mapping across campus switches and prevents conflicting PVIDs.

explanations.decision: Configured Native VLAN 99 as untagged and unused on all trunks
explanations.rationale: Setting the native VLAN to an unused ID (VLAN 99) and disallowing default VLAN 1 mitigates 802.1Q double-tagging and VLAN hopping security vulnerabilities.

explanations.decision: Restricted trunk links to explicitly allowed VLAN list [10,20,30,40,50]
explanations.rationale: Explicit allowed-VLAN pruning confines broadcast/multicast traffic strictly to authorized switches, conserving backplane bandwidth.

explanations.decision: Selected Single-Area OSPF (Area 0) for Campus LAN
explanations.rationale: Campus LAN operates within a single autonomous system with 5 subnets (less than the 50-subnet threshold). OSPF Area 0 provides fast link-state SPF convergence without multi-area ABR summarization complexity.

explanations.decision: Configured 1 OSPF area(s) with 5 network statements
explanations.rationale: Network statements map exact network-aligned CIDRs and inverse wildcard masks directly from the VLSM plan, ensuring flawless LSDB population.

checks.name: Bitwise Zero-Overlap Invariant
checks.detail: All allocated subnets are strictly disjoint (zero overlap).

checks.name: Root Network Containment Check
checks.detail: All subnets are contained within root block 10.20.0.0/16.

checks.name: Gateway Subnet Belonging Check
checks.detail: All gateway IP addresses belong to their respective subnet address blocks.

checks.name: Wildcard Mask Inversion Check
checks.detail: All wildcard masks independently verified against bitwise complement (~netmask).

checks.name: Host Capacity Sufficiency Check
checks.detail: All carved subnets provide usable host capacity >= requested demand.

checks.name: VLAN Safety & Native Hardening Check
checks.detail: VLAN IDs are unique, within range 1..4094, and native VLAN 99 is unused for access.

checks.name: Link Endpoint Existence Check
checks.detail: All physical and logical links terminate on valid, known devices.

checks.name: Physical Media Feasibility Check
checks.detail: All physical link runs strictly obey IEEE 802.3 transceiver reach limits.

checks.name: Routing Advertisement Consistency Check
checks.detail: All OSPF network statements map directly to allocated VLSM subnets.
